card.name: Linking words in old-fashioned prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, as, can, are, he in archaic or literary narrative prose, just before a manner or degree phrase like "the least possible friction" or "much in favor".

modes.label: with before manner
modes.description: The word with introduces how something happens, often a quality or feeling.
